items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 77:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the entry of the Creator into the Garden of Eden? The Keter of Rachel, which returns her nine Sefirot to their degree at midnight, upon which nine are attached the bodies of the souls of the righteous, which are thereby brought out from within the Klipot to holiness, is discerned as the entry of the Creator into the Garden of Eden, to delight with the souls of the righteous. For the Keter is the Creator, and the connection with his nine Sefirot, which are in Beriah, is discerned as an entry into the Garden of Eden, for the Garden of Eden is Beriah. And He delights there with the souls that were returned to holiness, as above. (Item 42).
